fact: Tanzania upgraded the RITA system so users can apply online for, track and receive birth registration documents via the eRITA platform, with certificates issued within 48 hours, per the Constitutional and Legal Affairs Minister.
ZCSRA says a web-based eCRVS platform and Sheha Mobile App, redeveloped from 2022, now carry birth registration in all 11 Zanzibar districts down to Sheha level.
ZCSRA says death registration, with births, marriages and divorces, is decentralised to Sheha level through the eCRVS platform in all 11 Zanzibar districts.
RITA launched issuance of birth certificates within 48 working hours through the eRITA system on 12 December 2025, with 11.5 million birth certificates issued by 25 November 2025 per the Minister.
RITA says eRITA is a single digital platform and the only system used for CRVS, registering births, deaths, marriages, divorces and adoptions, with registration ongoing across all 26 regions.
RITA says deaths are among the vital events registered on the eRITA single digital platform.
NIDA says eRITA issues a birth certificate in 48 hours, with online applications and digitized records, and 9.4 million under-5s registered.
